# Reachwise Professor Outreach

> Free web app that helps students email professors for international research internships (TEEP and IIPP in Taiwan, research internships abroad) and PhD or master's admission.

- Personalised emails sent from the student's own Gmail, one at a time, with three rotating versions of the first email
- Follow-ups after 5 days, only to professors who have not replied, in the same thread
- Reply tracking: same thread, a professor's personal address (matched by name and signature), the spam folder, and bounced emails
- Works with any free AI (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to write the emails from the student's CV; no paid AI needed
- Gmail app password stored encrypted; nothing is sent without the student pressing Send
